integrity: Exact symbolic 41-monomial gap identity and barycentric optimality proof; packaged Python-standard-library checker replayed against actual generated files; finite enumeration q=2..6 corroborates but is not the infinite proof. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved for the unit simplex-sum realization Q_{K_{2,q},2}, all integers q>=2, in the native Euclidean metric; not for arbitrary weights, higher m, general K_{p,q} or affine variants. Related indexed publications were sometimes available as summaries only; global historical priority and independent validation are unestablished.
title: Sharp outer sphere and factorial contact orbit of two-hub 2-graph polytopes
